name: Database Mart vLLM benchmark, A100 40GB PCIe, 50 concurrent
notes: Database Mart hosted-GPU report, page footer dated 10/07/2026. Engine is vLLM built from github.com/vllm-project/vllm with no release tag or commit printed, so the engine version is unpinned. Weights are the Hugging Face checkpoint at the precision the table labels 'Quantization 16' (bf16/fp16 not distinguished); format_id is null because data/quantization/ has no fp16/bf16 record. Single GPU, tensor parallel 1. Input length fixed at 100 tokens, output length fixed at 600 tokens. The 'Output (tokens/s)' column is aggregate generated tokens across the concurrent requests divided by benchmark duration, NOT a per-request decode rate. Median TTFT is the median time to first token under that same concurrency. Third-party measurement by the GPU host; confidence capped because the harness and the vLLM commit are unpublished. Card: the page says 'Nvidia A100' and the spec block (Ampere, 6,912 CUDA cores, 432 tensor cores, 40 GB HBM2, 19.5 TFLOPS FP32) is the 40 GB PCIe card, so records attach to nvidia-a100-40gb-pcie and not the 40 GB SXM4 or either 80 GB SKU. Request count 50 throughout. 14B rows needed --max-model-len 4096 to load.
